## Key identifiers and corrections
- Active schema: `billing_v3`; `billing_v1` is superseded and must never be seeded or written to because it is a frozen finance snapshot.
- Models: SQLAlchemy 2.0 `DeclarativeBase`; invoice lookup uses `session.get(Invoice, invoice_id)`.
- Timestamps: timezone-aware UTC via `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`.
- Logging: `ledgerly/logging.py`; request ID from `current_request_id` in `ledgerly/middleware.py`; use `structlog`, not `print()` or standard-library logging.
- Repository imports are explicit; `ledgerly/db.py` must not set `echo=True`.
- Release: `acme/acme-utils`, PyPI, version `2.8.0`; Stripe changes require an ADR link in `#billing-integrations` and `@priya`.
- Active issue: dunning scheduler reminders must not target paid customers.
- Hosts/buckets: none recorded.

## Recent work
- Fixed recurrence timezone handling in `src/ledgerly/scheduler/recurrence.py` by combining the run date, local time, and `schedule.tzinfo`, then converting to UTC. This preserves local wall time across DST transitions.
- Added/updated recurrence and logging regression tests. Midnight DST, recurring-invoice DST, and billing tests pass (`31 passed`); selected midnight DST test passed.
- Logging now includes `request_id`; health-log expectations were updated. Logging tests pass.
- Last full suite before the recurrence changes had one health-test failure; that test was subsequently fixed, but a fresh full-suite run remains outstanding.
- Release notes and `CHANGELOG.md` for `2.8.0` are complete. Remaining release work: commit/tag/push, build, twine validation, PyPI upload, and GitHub release.

- Invoice lookup uses `session.get(Invoice, invoice_id)`.
- Billing accepts an injected session; `finalize_invoice()` no longer creates a hidden transaction boundary.
- Invoice timestamps use `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`.
- Explicit model imports replaced wildcard imports in `ledgerly/repositories/customers.py` and `accounts.py`.
- Makefile seed target loads fixtures into PostgreSQL schema `billing_v1`.
- Stripe webhook changes require an ADR link in `#billing-integrations` and tagging `@priya`.
- Ledgerly logging must use `structlog` from the owning service; no `print()` or standard-library `logging`.
- Release project/repositories: `acme/acme-utils`, PyPI, tag `v2.8.0`; current package version is `2.8.0`.

- Invoice PDF header budgeting now reserves table headers once per document, preserving continuation-page headers; PDF tests passed (`14 passed, 1 skipped`) and four goldens remained byte-stable. Broader billing tests passed (`83 passed, 4 skipped`).

Relevant suites passed: repository tests (`83 passed`), invoice repository tests (`19 passed`), billing service tests (`26 passed`). Full baseline was `148 passed, 2 skipped`.
- Continued the broader maintenance/refactor work, including explicit repository imports; `compileall` passed. Visual comparison of three generated PDFs remains useful.
